commits.subject: Fix tests for integer 0 in wrapper functions that forgot to call |is_zero|
Make matrix code more robust against undefined behaviour for empty vectors.
Improve documentation of |reducibility_points|, both for users and C++ readers
Use a linked list rather than a vector in |root_coradical| and |coroot_radical|
Improve some script comments; add versions of |from_no_Cplus| and 'minus' friend.
Clarify that built-in |status@(int,KGBElt)| works with arbitrary roots
Wrap |add_history| so atlas builds with GNU readline don't choke on macOS libedit
Add forgotten |const| qualifiers to a number of |operator()| instances.
Merge branch 'latest' with some fixes that matter for Mac's into 'master'
